source: Three VehicleManager exports generated by the City on 17 August 2026 (systems 10:38, sharing 10:40, users 10:42).
universal_caveat: These are settings and inventory rows in a platform snapshot. None of them establishes use.

sharing.agencies_label: at least 155 configured outbound sharing relationships
sharing.jurisdictions_label: 36 states and the District of Columbia

systems.counting_convention: Top-level system rows are counted as systems; rows nested beneath them are counted as cameras.
systems.alternative_convention: Counting the 7 IP lane units as cameras rather than systems yields 142 systems and 567 cameras. Earlier RDP working notes used that shorthand.
systems.anomaly: One Mobile row is literally named “Unit number,” so any vehicle count read off that row total is off by at least one on the face of the file.

accounts.names_policy: No account name appears anywhere in this exhibit.
accounts.caveat: Accounts are not people. The list includes duplicates, API, proxy and site accounts, and one account on a vendor domain.

quantity_sequence.label: Four unit counts, four sources, no reconciliation
quantity_sequence.caveat: No record reconciles all four. This exhibit publishes all four with their sources and offers no explanation for the differences.
